status: NON-EXECUTABLE EDITORIAL RESEARCH ONLY. No production code, photos or user data changed.
scope: 10 distinct Commons file pages: 2 each for Czechia, Slovakia, Hungary, Slovenia and Croatia. Captions describe depicted sites, not necessarily the atlas gateway pin location.
method: Opened each exact Commons file page and checked author, own-work/source statement, description and the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence. Record is provisional until image pixels, rights chain and attribution presentation are reviewed.
displayRequirements: Before use: verify the rendered image depicts the intended site, show visible photographer, file-page and licence links; identify edits and comply with share-alike terms for derivatives; verify actual URLs and offline availability. Do not substitute unverified Commons search results.
